welcome:
👋 Welcome to AviaTicketSearchBot!

I can find flights using Aviasales Data API, show ticket options, and track price changes. Use the menu or type a natural-language request.
search.origin_prompt: Where are you flying from? Enter a city, airport, or IATA code.
search.destination_prompt: Where are you flying to? Enter a city, airport, or IATA code.
search.location_not_found: ❌ I could not find a city or airport. Enter an IATA code, city, or airport, for example: AMS, Moscow, Heathrow.
search.location_choose: I found several options. Please choose one:
search.same_route: ❌ Destination must be different from origin.
calendar.after_departure: Return date cannot be earlier than departure date.
confirm.title: I understood your request. Please confirm:
search.no_results: 😔 No tickets found. Try another date or route.
search.api_error: ❌ Search failed because of an API error. Please try again later.
search.source_notice: ℹ️ Prices are from Aviasales Data API cached user searches. Check the final price via the Travelpayouts partner link before buying.
nearby.prompt: Would you like to see nearby dates prices?
